pr.body:
## Summary

- **Status drift 해소**: SPEC 구현은 PR #718 (2026-04-26)을 통해 main에 머지 완료된 상태였으나 `spec.md` `status: in-progress` drift 잔존. `completed`로 갱신.
- **Plan-Audit P3 cosmetic 보강**: 2026-05-15 plan-auditor 검증(PASS 0.91)에서 식별된 P3 defects D2/D3/D4를 함께 해소.
- 구현 자체에는 변경 없음 — 본 PR은 documentation + 보조 test 추가에 한정.

## Changes

- **spec.md**: `status: completed`, `version: 0.2.0`, §2.2.1 REQ-DFF-003 enforcement note 추가 (D2)
- **acceptance.md**: AC-DFF-06 "BRIEF-X" → "BRIEF-X.md" 명시화 (D4)
- **internal/cli/design_folder_test.go**:
  - `TestDesignFolderUpdate_NilErrOut` 신규 (D3 — nil errOut 안전성 검증)
  - `TestDesignFolderUpdate_MultipleReservedConflicts` keyword 강화 (D4)
- **progress.md**: Run phase resolution + plan-audit defects 처리 entry 신규 작성

## Quality Gate

- 12/12 design_folder 테스트 GREEN (신규 `NilErrOut` 포함)
- \`go test ./...\` PASS
- \`go test -race ./internal/cli/...\` PASS
- \`golangci-lint run\` 0 issues
- \`make build\` Success

## Plan-Audit P3 Defects 상세

| ID | Status | 처리 |
|----|--------|------|
| D1 (P2) | DEFERRED | REQ-DFF-008 State-Driven split — cosmetic only, EARS 의미 보존됨 |
| D2 (P3) | RESOLVED | spec.md §2.2.1 — API contract 수준 enforcement 명시 |
| D3 (P3) | RESOLVED | TestDesignFolderUpdate_NilErrOut 추가 |
| D4 (P3) | RESOLVED | "BRIEF-X" → "BRIEF-X.md" tightened |

## Refs

- PR #718 (구현 머지, 2026-04-26)
- SPEC-DESIGN-CONST-AMEND-001 (reserved name 정책 출처)
- \`.moai/reports/plan-audit/SPEC-V3R3-DESIGN-FOLDER-FIX-001-2026-05-15.md\` (auditor 보고서, gitignored)

## Test plan

- [x] design_folder 12개 테스트 GREEN
- [x] go vet / golangci-lint clean
- [x] race detection PASS
- [x] template-first mirror unchanged (constitution.md 본 PR 변경 없음)
- [x] No regression in other tests

🗿 MoAI <email@mo.ai.kr>
